deliverables: research/assets/forex_free_v3/family2.py exposes run_arm(arm, data_paths, macro_reader, freeze_token=None) -> {decisions, financing_events, meta} for arms anchor / neighbour / causal_negative_control (driver shorthand 'control' normalized). Decisions only at completed daily 16:00 America/New_York flat H1 bars (weekday Mon-Fri; 20:00Z EDT / 21:00Z EST via zoneinfo); entry/exit fills at the OPEN of the next EXISTING 16:00-NY bar (one-event lag; missing next bar => action skipped fail-closed and recorded in meta.skipped_decisions with reason MISSING_NEXT_FILL_BAR).

Vol regime from price history ONLY, exact window in meta.vol_regime_window: 20-NY-day current block, 10 prior non-overlapping 20-day blocks, 220 completed valid NY-days warmup; anchor S = mean(rr), B = median of the 10 block means (median of 10 = mean of the two middle order statistics); LOW iff S < B strictly (S == B => HIGH). rr_d = sum of H1 true ranges of the window bars / the day's 16:00-NY close; window = bars strictly after the previous enumerated NY weekday's decision bar through the day's decision bar; window must be consecutive hourly except the single structural Fri->Mon weekend close, else the day is invalid (fail-closed NO_EVAL); provider Sat/Sun-UTC-stamped artifacts are excluded from the walk. Neighbour: S/B are sample stds (ddof=1) of the 19 close-to-close log returns inside the same 20-day windows (identical 220-day warmup).

Direction read EXCLUSIVELY through the injected availability-gated macro_reader (differential at the decision instant; available_time_utc <= T enforced by the reader, never bypassed); None or exact zero => pair-day NO_EVAL. Causal negative control: direction from the FROZEN sham derangement (base and quote legs rotated +2 along the frozen pair order, spec mapping reproduced exactly: EUR/USD->(AU,US), GBP/USD->(NZ,US), AUD/USD->(US,JP), NZD/USD->(US,CH), USD/JPY->(US,CA), USD/CHF->(EMU,USD), USD/CAD->(GB,US)); the rotation constant IS the recorded seed (meta.sham_derangement.seed) -- deterministic, no runtime randomness, identity-free (asserted at import and in tests).

Fold boundaries 2022-05-01 / 2024-07-01 force flat: an open position exits at the OPEN of the last decision day's 16:00-NY bar before the boundary with force_flat=true; an entry whose fill would land on that bar is suppressed (skipped_decision FOLD_BOUNDARY_NO_ENTRY); post-boundary decisions may open positions in the next fold (no position crosses a boundary).

Financing events one per decision, formula id 'V3_FROZEN_POLICY_RATE_CARRY' (all events of an arm carry the same id): adjustment = sign * notional(10000) * sum(day-start as-of differentials in decimals)/365 over calendar days [entry-fill date, exit-fill date); weekend days carry the most recent prior weekday decision instant; adopted percent-per-annum vintages converted to decimals (/100) exactly once at the family financing boundary (disclosed in meta.financing.units); approximation disclosure carried verbatim in meta.financing.disclosed_approximation (policy rates are unsecured official rates, NOT swap/OIS rollover).

assumptions: data_paths contract for this family: {'h1_dir': <dir with {SYMBOL}_1h_*.json TwelveData-format files>, 'macro_vintages': {...} (read by the runner-built reader)}. Provider no-data error payloads are empty windows (recorded evidence), not failures.

Decision ts convention: the enumerated H1 bar whose America/New_York wall time is 16:00 (A9-F definition); decision_ts carries that UTC stamp; fills use the next existing such bar's OPEN (open-stamped provider bars).

Neighbour S/B use the 19 close-to-close log returns inside each 20-NY-day window (aligned with the anchor's windows, identical 220-day warmup); the proposal's 'sigma of the 20 most recent returns' is ambiguous by one, and this choice keeps everything_else byte-identical to the anchor as the spec requires.
Financing units: adopted vintages are percent-per-annum (per the P0 fixture/adapter convention); /100 conversion applied exactly once family-side; direction sign is unit-invariant.
